rule: A JSON file counts as Gazelle's constitution when the knowledge graph holds it.

links.note: The graph holds a rule as files the codebase carries, so a rule held outside it would confer status that no rebuild reproduces.

violations: Rule followed that no JSON file in the knowledge graph carries.
Foundation or regulative rule treated as advisory because it is not a constitutive one.
graph.md edited directly rather than the node it is generated from.
Constitution read as documentation of what the code already does.
